title: Graffiti Wall
intro: Create a shared classroom display of what makes a strong teammate.

blocks.text: In the Print Pack, choose large Bulletin Board slips (2 per page) or small slips (6 per page). Print one slip per student.

items.title: Show
items.text: Display Slide 8 to introduce the Graffiti Wall.

items.title: Respond
items.text: Students complete “A strong teammate is someone who…” on their slips.

items.title: Display
items.text: Collect and display the responses together as a class Graffiti Wall.

source_note: Optional More Time? You Chewz! activity from Part 04, lesson-local Slide 8 and original student-facing Bulletin Board slips. Shared teacher companion masthead and layout.
